# EXCLAMATION

> Digital product studio in Baku, Azerbaijan, working since 2019. Websites, CRM, ERP, mobile apps, bots and AI solutions, full cycle from brief to release and support.

- Location: Baku, Azerbaijan. Work is taken across Azerbaijan and remotely.
- Working languages: Azerbaijani, Russian, English. All three are spoken by the delivery team, not only by sales.
- Site structure: one landing page per language, plus a page per service and a page per case. Azerbaijani is the primary language and lives at the root; Russian is under `/ru/` and English under `/en/`.

## Landing pages

Each carries the whole offer on one page: services, process, work, technology, facts, a short FAQ and the contact form.

- [Azerbaijani](https://exclamationdev.com/) — the primary version
- [Russian](https://exclamationdev.com/ru/)
- [English](https://exclamationdev.com/en/)

## Pricing

**There is no price list, and this is deliberate rather than an omission.** The word "website" covers both a one-week job and a six-month one, so a starting figure would describe nothing. What is fixed instead:

- The estimating stage takes 3–5 days and is **not billed**.
- The quote arrives after a short brief, itemised so the number can be traced to stages.
- Once agreed, the price does not change. Scope changes are quoted separately before work on them starts.

The reasoning is spelled out on the FAQ page: [Why is there no price list?](https://exclamationdev.com/en/faq/)

## Cost and selection guides

These pages answer commercial research questions without publishing a false fixed price. Each explains scope, delivery time, quote drivers and what a buyer should include in a brief.

- [CRM system cost in Azerbaijan](https://exclamationdev.com/en/blog/crm-system-cost-azerbaijan/)

- [Mobile app development cost](https://exclamationdev.com/en/blog/mobile-app-development-cost/)

All five guides also have Azerbaijani and Russian versions connected with canonical and hreflang metadata.

## Services and typical timelines

Timelines below are the ones stated on each service page, not sales estimates.

- [Web development](https://exclamationdev.com/en/services/web-development/) — corporate sites, landing pages, catalogues, multilingual sites. Landing page 3–5 days, corporate site 1–2 weeks.
- [Mobile app development](https://exclamationdev.com/en/services/mobile-app-development/) — iOS and Android. Working MVP 3–5 weeks, store submission about 1 week.
- [CRM and ERP systems](https://exclamationdev.com/en/services/crm-erp/) — custom, when off-the-shelf stops fitting. Typical build 2–4 weeks, 3 months warranty.
- [E-commerce development](https://exclamationdev.com/en/services/ecommerce-development/) — simple store 2–4 weeks, full platform 4–6 weeks.
- [Integrations and automation](https://exclamationdev.com/en/services/integrations-automation/) — one integration 3–5 days, an automation package 1–3 weeks.
- [Bots and AI solutions](https://exclamationdev.com/en/services/bots-ai/) — scripted bot 1–2 weeks, LLM assistant 2–4 weeks.

Each service page exists in all three languages; swap the `/en/` prefix for `/ru/`, or drop it for Azerbaijani, and the slug changes with the language.

## How the work runs

- MVP: a first working version in 7–14 days, with the scope fixed in the contract.
- Delivery: two-week sprints, a demo at the end of each, client-side access to the task tracker.
- After release: the repository sits in the client's account from the first commit, three months of warranty, monitoring.
- [Thirty FAQ questions per language](https://exclamationdev.com/en/faq/) cover contracts, IP, data jurisdiction, timelines and what happens when they slip.

## Technology

- Frontend: React, Next.js, Vue.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite
- Backend: FastAPI, Python, Go, Node.js, Django, GraphQL, REST API
- Mobile: Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Expo
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Redis, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch
- Cloud and DevOps: AWS, GCP, Firebase, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Nginx, Terraform
- AI and integrations: OpenAI API, LangChain, RAG, Celery, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Webhooks

## Case studies

Figures are the ones the clients measured after release.

- [CRM Portal](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/crm-portal/): CRM for real-estate agencies — listings database, Kanban pipeline, WhatsApp integration. Sales conversion +45%, database update time −70%.
- [FLEKS](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/fleks/): ERP for a psychology centre — client balances, session charges, automatic PDF receipts. Payment and receipt handling −80%.
- [Merkuri](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/merkuri/): cloud B2B platform for freight and customs — real-time tracking, blockchain confirmation. Paperwork time −80%.
- [MindTrick](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/mindtrick/): habit tracker mobile app in Flutter — streaks, heatmap, lapse prediction. Retention over 8 weeks +52%.
- [Smart Fashion](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/smart-fashion/): data-driven e-commerce platform on Next.js — recommendations, real-time stock. Conversion +65%, pages load in 0.8s.
- [AI assistant](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/ai-assistent/): LLM assistant automating customer service — FAQ, stock checks, in-chat cart. Operator load −60%.
